BLACK FRIDAY DEAL
Save $500
HBBC DTR Premium: Moto-Style Fat Tire Scrambler eBikeThe DTR Premium in Flat Black was made for the coast. Stealthy, sharp, and effortlessly cool, this colorway channels the Huntington Beach lifestyle from the strand to the street — and everywhere in between. Designed in Huntington Beach for riders who want strong acceleration, useful range, and a plush ride without a long list of aftermarket upgrades. The DTR Premium pairs a Bafang 750W motor with a 24A controller for up to 1,152W peak output and 80 Nm of torque. It is a fully equipped, high-performance scrambler made for coastal cruising, commuting, and everyday street riding.Why choose the DTR Premium?

California Class 2 designation: The DTR Premium is listed as a Class 2 eBike, with 20 mph throttle operation and up to 28 mph pedal assist, subject to local laws.

UL-certified safety design: The bike is UL 2849-certified, and its battery is UL 2771-certified.

Strong, responsive power: The 750W Bafang motor, 24A controller, 80 Nm of torque, and up to 1,152W peak output are tuned for confident starts and hill-climbing performance.

Large 48V/19.2Ah battery (921.6Wh): The battery uses premium LG 21700 cells and is UL 2771-certified. Estimated range is 35–45 miles on throttle-only riding. Actual range varies with rider weight, terrain, speed, temperature, tire pressure, and assist level. The throttle-only figure is measured in Eco Mode at 20 mph.

Deliberate 48V architecture: HBBC chose a 48V platform to balance acceleration, thermal management, and long-term component reliability. The system is designed to deliver the performance you need without unnecessary electrical stress or overpowering the motor.

Plush, adjustable ride: The adjustable front suspension fork includes a lockout, and the Super Soft Tuck/Roll saddle helps smooth out everyday bumps.

Hydraulic disc brakes: Tektro hydraulic brakes provide controlled, responsive stopping for daily street and coastal riding.

*Range varies by rider weight, terrain, speed, temperature, tire pressure, and assist level. Throttle-only range is measured in Eco Mode at 20 mph.Top-speed availability and permitted operation may vary by local laws.DTR Premium FAQWhat California eBike classification does the DTR Premium use?The DTR Premium is listed as a Class 2 eBike, with 20 mph throttle operation and up to 28 mph pedal assist, subject to local laws.What safety certifications apply to the bike and battery?The bike is UL 2849-certified, and the battery is UL 2771-certified.How much power does the DTR Premium have?The DTR Premium uses a Bafang 750W motor and 24A controller, with 80 Nm of torque and up to 1,152W peak output.What battery does it use?It uses a 48V/19.2Ah, 921.6Wh UL 2771-certified battery pack with premium LG 21700 cells.What is the maximum payload?The DTR Premium has a maximum payload of 325 lb.How far can I ride on one charge?Plan on an estimated 35–45 miles with throttle-only riding. Real-world range depends on how and where you ride.Does the Premium include suspension and hydraulic brakes?Yes. It includes an adjustable front suspension fork with lockout and Tektro hydraulic disc brakes.
